accueil:
What do you want to start from?

Templates shipped with FreeCAD are never modified: saving goes to your own templates folder.
act_declarer_dossier: Set my folder as TechDraw template folder
famille_non_enregistre: ⚠ The open template has unsaved changes: the other sizes will include them, the open file will not (Ctrl+S to save it).
info_reduction: margin text “{nom}” reduced from {avant} to {apres} to fit in the margin.
aide_champ: The text is the default value of the field in TechDraw. X and Y give the anchor point of the text (its baseline).
aide_rotation_impossible: This text is distorted (skew, mirror or unequal scale): its orientation cannot be set here.
aide_groupe: A group moves with everything it contains.
aide_pas: Snap step for moves, in millimetres. 0 = none. While dragging: Alt moves freely, Shift keeps horizontal or vertical.
aide_proportions_aucune: Width or height zero, in percent or in different units: proportions cannot be kept, width and height are set separately.
aide_proportions_cadre: Image not embedded in the template, or unreadable: the proportions kept are those of the current frame.
aide_souris:
Click an element to select it, drag it to move it.
Ctrl+click: add or remove. Drag on empty space: select an area.
Arrows: move the selection by one step (Shift: ten steps), or scroll the view when nothing is selected.
ano_champ_double: {compte} fields are named "{nom}": TechDraw will make a single one of them
ano_champ_sans_tspan: field "{nom}" has no <tspan>: TechDraw will not see it
ano_echelle: one document unit is {unite} mm instead of 1: TechDraw will show shifted dimensions
ano_id_double: id "{id}" of field "{nom}" is carried by several elements
chk_coupe: Trimming marks at the four corners
chk_grille: Grid reference system (ticks, numbers and letters)
chk_remplacer_cartouche: First remove everything that is not the frame
dlg_dossier: Folder where my templates are saved
err_autofill_pas_champ: Autofill only applies to an editable field.
err_cartouche_echelle: The title block and the template do not have the same scale (units per millimetre).
err_cartouche_references: This title block contains elements that refer to others by id (gradient, pattern, clip, symbol: "url(#…)" or "href="#…""). The macro cannot copy them yet without breaking those references; nothing was changed.
err_cartouche_sans_trace: The selection contains no drawn shape (rectangle, line…): the title block size would be unknown. Add its outline to the selection.
err_cartouche_vide: This title block file contains no graphic element.
err_champ_doublon: Another field is already named "{nom}". Two fields with the same name would be a single one in TechDraw.
err_champ_pas_texte: Only a text can become an editable field.
err_document_partiel: Document "{document}" is only partially loaded: FreeCAD would not save the change. Open it fully, then try again.
err_dossier_protege: {chemin} is inside the FreeCAD installation folder: pick another folder.
err_echelle: This template is not at 1 unit = 1 mm; the macro cannot change its sheet size.
err_element_detache: This element no longer belongs to the template.
err_hors_freecad: This command is only available inside FreeCAD.
err_image_type: Unsupported file type for a logo (PNG, JPEG or SVG): {chemin}
err_marges: The margins leave no room for the drawing.
err_pas: The tick spacing must be positive.
err_pas_structure: This template has no frame identified as "drawing_space_frame".
err_pas_svg: This file is not an SVG document.
err_pas_un_trait: This path is not a two-point line.
err_proportions_nulle: Keeping the proportions would make the other dimension zero: the value is refused. Enlarge the logo, or untick "Keep proportions".
err_rendu: The Qt SVG renderer rejects this document; the operation was dropped and nothing was changed.
err_sans_taille: The SVG document has neither a viewBox nor dimensions.
err_template_illisible:
TechDraw cannot read this template ({detail}): {chemin}
The page was not changed.
err_transform_singulier: This element is placed by a non-invertible transform; it cannot be moved.
err_rotation_transform: This text, or a group containing it, is placed by a transform with a skew, a mirror or an unequal scale; rotating it would destroy it. Nothing was changed.
info_champs_renommes:
Some title block fields had a name already in use; they were renamed:
{liste}
info_debordement:
{compte} title block element(s) extend beyond the drawing frame: {liste}.
Nothing was corrected: move them or pick a smaller title block.
info_pas_de_page: No TechDraw page is selected or open in the active document.
info_pas_dossier_freecad: The FreeCAD templates folder was not found; pick the file by hand.
info_pas_structure:
This template does not have the structure of the FreeCAD ISO 5457 templates (a frame identified as "drawing_space_frame"): the macro cannot tell the frame from the title block, and does not guess.

To move it to another size: select the title block elements (drag an area around them), then Template › Export selection as title block. Then create a new template of the wanted size with this title block.
info_selection_cartouche: First select the title block elements (drag an area around them).
nav_base: Navigation — FreeCAD default style: drag with the middle button to pan, wheel to zoom, right click for the menu.
nav_blender: Navigation — Blender: left + right drag, or Shift + middle drag, to pan; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_cad: Navigation — CAD: middle drag to pan, middle click to centre; Ctrl + right click then Ctrl + move to pan, Ctrl + Shift + right click then move to zoom; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_gesture: Navigation — Gesture: right drag to pan, right click for the menu; wheel to zoom.
nav_inventor: Navigation — OpenInventor: middle drag to pan, left + middle drag to zoom; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_maya: Navigation — Maya-Gesture: Alt + middle drag to pan, Alt + right drag to zoom; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_occ: Navigation — OpenCascade: middle drag to pan, Ctrl + left drag to zoom; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_openscad: Navigation — OpenSCAD: right drag to pan, middle (or Shift + right) drag to zoom; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_revit: Navigation — Revit: middle, or left + right, drag to pan; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_solidworks: Navigation — SolidWorks: middle drag to pan, Shift + middle drag to zoom; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_tinkercad: Navigation — TinkerCAD: middle drag to pan; wheel to zoom; right click for the menu.
nav_touchpad: Navigation — Touchpad: Shift + move to pan, Ctrl + Shift + move or Page Up/Down to zoom; right click for the menu.
note_cartouche: The title block is placed in the bottom-right corner of the drawing frame and stays selected: drag it to put it elsewhere.
note_cartouche_libre: This template has no recognised frame: the title block is placed 10 mm from the bottom-right corner of the sheet and stays selected so you can drag it into place.
note_format: The frame is rebuilt for the new sheet size. Everything else — the title block — follows the bottom-right corner of the drawing frame.
note_nouveau: The frame follows the ISO 5457 templates shipped with FreeCAD. The title block is placed in the bottom-right corner of the drawing frame.
q_appliquer:
Apply "{fichier}" to page "{page}" of document "{document}"?

Values of fields that keep the same name are preserved.

Warning: if you then undo this operation in FreeCAD (Ctrl+Z), the former template comes back with its default values, not with yours; Ctrl+Y brings them back. This is how FreeCAD behaves.
q_enregistrer_avant: The template must first be saved in your folder. Save it now?
q_modifie: The template has been modified. Save the changes?
q_quelle_page: Which page should receive the template?
